capabilities.description: Read anything the connected user can see in UC San Diego Kuali Build: apps, app setup (forms and workflows), documents, users, and workflow status, plus any GraphQL query.

Create and edit anything the connected user can in Kuali Build: apps, forms, workflows, and documents, including publishing apps and approving, denying, sending back, or withdrawing documents. Each change needs approval, can change university records and every future submission, and is never automatically retried.
capabilities.displayName: Create and edit in Kuali Build

capabilities.description: Delete apps, documents, and workflows, and run any other GraphQL request that deletes or discards data. Each deletion needs approval, may not be reversible, and is never automatically retried.

tenantUrl.description: The fixed UC San Diego Kuali Build origin.

description: Read, build, and edit UC San Diego Kuali Build apps, forms, workflows, and documents through its GraphQL API, with separate read, write, and delete permissions and host approval for every change.
name: Kuali Build

skills.description: Read, build, and edit UC San Diego Kuali Build apps, forms, workflows, and documents safely, using the dedicated tools first and general GraphQL when they don't cover the task.
skills.name: ucsd-kuali-build

tools.description: List a bounded set of Build app IDs and names visible to the connected UCSD Kuali user.
tools.name: kuali-build.apps.list

tools.description: Read one exact Build app by its 24-character hexadecimal app ID.
tools.name: kuali-build.apps.get

tools.description: Read the current published form field keys and labels for one exact Build app before interpreting or editing document data.
tools.name: kuali-build.forms.schema

tools.description: List a bounded page of document IDs for one Build app, with optional text, workflow-status, and updated-since filters.
tools.name: kuali-build.documents.list

tools.description: Read one exact Build document's data and metadata, including meta.updatedAt required by the safe update tool.
tools.name: kuali-build.documents.get

tools.description: Overwrite only the supplied formKey values on one existing document after a best-effort meta.updatedAt stale check. Null values may clear data and require explicit confirmation. Does not submit the document or change workflow state.

dataJson.description: The same object as data, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send data or dataJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.documents.update

tools.description: Immediately create one empty draft and workflow action in the selected app. This is non-idempotent and is only phase one of a non-atomic creation flow; do not retry an unknown outcome.
tools.name: kuali-build.documents.drafts.initialize

tools.description: Read the app and draft document IDs created for one exact initialization action ID. This is the read-only second phase of document creation.
tools.name: kuali-build.documents.drafts.resolve

tools.description: Submit one initialized draft with bounded form data and fixed status completed, starting its configured workflow. This is non-idempotent, may be difficult to reverse, and is not atomic with draft initialization.

dataJson.description: The same object as data, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send data or dataJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.documents.submit

tools.description: Look up a bounded set of UCSD Kuali users by school ID, email, username, or name text.
tools.name: kuali-build.users.lookup

tools.description: Read workflow status metadata for one exact Build document.
tools.name: kuali-build.workflows.status

tools.description: Browse the Kuali Build GraphQL schema. Without typeName, lists root queries and mutations (each mutation shows whether it needs write or admin) and type names, optionally filtered by search. With typeName, returns that type's fields, arguments, input fields, and enum values.
tools.name: kuali-build.graphql.schema

tools.description: Run one read-only GraphQL query against UCSD Kuali Build with the connected user's permissions. Use kuali-build.graphql.schema first to find fields. Returns data plus any sanitized Kuali error messages.

document.description: One GraphQL operation. Fragments are allowed; subscriptions, multiple operations, @defer, and @stream are not.

variables.description: GraphQL variables as a JSON object.

variablesJson.description: The same object as variables, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send variables or variablesJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.graphql.query

tools.description: Run one GraphQL mutation that creates or edits something (anything except deletes). Mutations whose names indicate deleting or discarding are refused with admin_required. Show the user the exact mutation and variables, then set confirmMutation to true. Never retried; an unknown outcome must be checked in Kuali before trying again.
tools.displayName: Run Kuali Build create or edit request

document.description: One GraphQL operation. Fragments are allowed; subscriptions, multiple operations, @defer, and @stream are not.

variables.description: GraphQL variables as a JSON object.

variablesJson.description: The same object as variables, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send variables or variablesJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.graphql.mutate

tools.description: Run one GraphQL mutation that deletes or discards something. Other mutations are refused; use kuali-build.graphql.mutate for them. Show the user exactly what will be deleted, then set confirmMutation to true. Never retried; an unknown outcome must be checked in Kuali before trying again.

document.description: One GraphQL operation. Fragments are allowed; subscriptions, multiple operations, @defer, and @stream are not.

variables.description: GraphQL variables as a JSON object.

variablesJson.description: The same object as variables, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send variables or variablesJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.graphql.delete

tools.description: Read one app's setup as its builders see it: pages, draft and publish state, the form template, the main workflow, and secondary workflows. Read this before editing a form or workflow and send back the edited structure.
tools.name: kuali-build.apps.configuration.get

tools.description: Create a new, empty Kuali Build app tile, optionally in a space. Add its form with kuali-build.forms.update and publish it with kuali-build.apps.publish.

backgroundColor.description: App tile color. Only Kuali's app palette is accepted. Leave it out and one is picked.

iconName.description: Kuali app icon file name, for example app-window.svg, archive.svg, or accounting-calculator.svg. Other names are refused before anything is sent. Leave it out to use app-window.svg.

tools.name: kuali-build.apps.create

tools.description: Create a new app by copying an existing app's setup.

backgroundColor.description: App tile color. Only Kuali's app palette is accepted.

iconName.description: Kuali app icon file name, for example app-window.svg, archive.svg, or accounting-calculator.svg. Other names are refused before anything is sent.

tools.name: kuali-build.apps.copy

tools.description: Change an app's name, tile color, or icon.

backgroundColor.description: App tile color. Only Kuali's app palette is accepted.

iconName.description: Kuali app icon file name, for example app-window.svg, archive.svg, or accounting-calculator.svg. Other names are refused before anything is sent.

tools.name: kuali-build.apps.update

tools.description: Replace an app's draft form template with the supplied template JSON, as the form builder's save does. Start from the template returned by kuali-build.apps.configuration.get. Changes stay in draft until the app is published.

templateJson.description: The same object as template, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send template or templateJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.forms.update

tools.description: Publish an app's draft form and workflow changes so new submissions use them. Publishing may not be reversible; tell the user what will change first.
tools.name: kuali-build.apps.publish

tools.description: Replace an app's workflow steps with the supplied steps array, as the workflow builder's save does. Start from the workflow returned by kuali-build.apps.configuration.get. Changes the approval route for future submissions once published.

stepsJson.description: The same array as steps, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send steps or stepsJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.workflows.update

tools.description: Add a secondary workflow to an app with a name and trigger type.
tools.name: kuali-build.workflows.secondary.create

tools.description: Publish a secondary workflow's saved draft. Secondary workflows are published separately from the app.
tools.name: kuali-build.workflows.secondary.publish

tools.description: Act on a document's pending workflow step identified by actionId. Use the status that matches the step type: completed (Initiate/submit), approved or rejected (Approval), task completed (Task), acknowledged (Acknowledge). Optional comment and form data. A kuali_rejected_action error (validationFailed, formOutOfDate, submissionsDisabled, Invalid Operation) means Kuali did not perform the action.
tools.displayName: Approve, deny, submit, or complete Build workflow step

dataJson.description: The same object as data, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send data or dataJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.documents.act

tools.description: Send a document back to an earlier workflow step.

bodyJson.description: The same object as body, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send body or bodyJson, not both.

dataJson.description: The same object as data, sent as JSON text. Use this when nested objects or arrays arrive empty; send data or dataJson, not both.

tools.name: kuali-build.documents.sendback

tools.description: Withdraw a submitted document from its workflow.
tools.name: kuali-build.documents.withdraw

tools.description: Create a new draft copy of a document.
tools.name: kuali-build.documents.duplicate

tools.description: Delete an app. This also removes its documents and may not be reversible.
tools.name: kuali-build.apps.delete

tools.description: Delete one document. This may not be reversible.
tools.name: kuali-build.documents.delete

tools.description: Delete one secondary workflow from an app.
tools.name: kuali-build.workflows.secondary.delete
